lines.text: These are the proverbs of Solomon son of David, king of Israel, for gaining wisdom and discipline.
The fear of the LORD is the beginning of knowledge, and the son must not forsake his mother's teaching.
The son is told to heed his father's instruction, which is a crown on his head and a pendant around his neck.
Sinners may entice the son to ambush the innocent, fill their houses with plunder, and share one purse.
The son must not walk their road, for they lie in wait for their own blood, the fate of all who are proud.
